description: React component for managing EF Source Mappings within an asset details page tab. It allows viewing, creating, editing, and validating EF source mapping records associated with an input parameter of an asset. The component interacts with API endpoints for CRUD operations and manages local state for form inputs, modals, errors, and loading states.

methods.name: EfSourceMappingTab
methods.description: Main React functional component for EF Source Mapping tab in asset details page, handling CRUD operations, form validation, and display.

methods.name: reload
methods.description: Fetches the list of EF source mappings for the current asset and selected input parameter, updating the component state.

methods.name: openCreate
methods.description: Initializes form state for creating a new EF source mapping and opens the modal dialog.

methods.name: openEdit
methods.description: Pre-fills form with existing data for editing an EF source mapping and opens the modal dialog.

methods.name: onSave
methods.description: Validates form inputs and either creates or updates an EF source mapping via API, then reloads the list.
